morphology.pattern_note: 不作马来语词缀拆分；正文通常写作 Nancy。所列音标为常见英语读法，具体人名以本人读法为准。

senses.zh_definition: 南希：女性名字；在马来语句子中用作专有名词。
senses.en_definition: Nancy, a feminine given name used as a proper noun.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang perempuan, lazimnya dieja Nancy. Takrif ini ialah huraian editorial, bukan takrif rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 输入没有提供正式马来语释义，因此不能标为已获官方确认的普通词条。这里按人名处理，不涵盖其他语言中的同形词或地名。马来西亚人名中的实际用例见[马来西亚国会人物档案](https://www.parlimen.gov.my/arkib-ahli.html?_print=true&arkib=yes&id=3725&lang=en&uweb=dr&vol=14)。以下搭配是自然的人名组合，不代表经过语料统计的高频搭配；排名仅沿用输入数据。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Puan Nancy akan membentangkan laporan kemajuan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 南希女士将在明天的会议上汇报项目进展。
dual_scenarios.en: Ms Nancy will present the project progress report at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Nancy dah sampai kat kafe ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Nancy sudah tiba di kafe?
dual_scenarios.en: Has Nancy reached the café yet?
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
kat 对应表示地点的 di。
句末 ke 构成口语疑问。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Nancy dah sampai kat kafe ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Nancy sudah tiba di kafe?
messages.en: Has Nancy reached the café yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia tunggu kat dalam. Jom masuk.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah tiba dan sedang menunggu di dalam. Mari kita masuk.
messages.zh: 到了，她在里面等着呢。我们进去吧。
messages.en: Yes, she's waiting inside. Let's go in.

etymology.historical_story: Nancy belongs to English personal-name history rather than Malay affixation. Name references connect it with medieval Annis and, in later usage, with Ann. A familiar form can eventually become an independent given name. Its appearance in Malaysian writing therefore identifies a person; it does not establish an ordinary Malay vocabulary meaning. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/nancy/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Nancy 与“南希”的人物名牌连起来记；这是名字，不必寻找马来语词根或词缀。
